summary: Internal review rejected the previous package for hype, unsupported claims, and weak source handling.

homepage_hero.headline: Meet the Revolutionary AI Teammate for Every Repo
homepage_hero.subheadline: A seamless all-purpose assistant that supercharges every coding workflow instantly.
homepage_hero.body: Zed now gives every engineer a 10x autonomous teammate that can handle any codebase without extra setup.

release_note.title: The future of AI coding is here
release_note.what_changed: We shipped a fully autonomous agent system.
release_note.how_it_works: It just knows what to do across every repository and every team.
release_note.why_it_matters: You can stop thinking about context and let the AI take over.

rejection_reasons: Leads with hype instead of the main product fact.
Invents 'every repo', 'instant', and 'fully autonomous' claims with no supporting source.
Fails to mention the Threads Sidebar or how work is organized.
Does not ground Codex or external-agent references in ACP.
Contains banned phrases and empty superlatives.
